scenarios.description: Application plugin BrowserWindow surface in the official dark theme
assertions: dark theme CSS declares color-scheme: dark and Material Symbols font-face declarations
theme.resolve injects dark canvas, surface, state and command consumer variables on documentElement
toolbar, menu-bar, context-menu and shortcut scopes have explicit dark data-scope selectors

scenarios.description: Sandboxed base card renderer/editor iframe surface in the official dark theme
assertions: base card iframe receives dark CSS and resolved token variables before component rendering
iframe contract components keep sandbox lifecycle metadata in theme-interface contract
media and error-state boundaries use dark semantic state colors instead of local card plugin skins

scenarios.description: Box layout renderer/editor iframe surface in the official dark theme
assertions: layout primitives consume chips.layout.* and chips.comp.* tokens
box layout iframe receives the same dark CSS and token variables as app windows
scroll and split layout selectors use public data-scope/data-part only

scenarios.description: Module configuration and diagnostics panel surface in the official dark theme
assertions: form, table and feedback components use dark theme package tokens instead of local skins
theme.contract.get reports complete required token coverage
diagnostics panels can render dark contract coverage without parsing private theme files
